answer: Late settlement is itself a sybil filter. The market holds each reward in an observation window and lets peers contest it with evidence. A farm of synthetic identities must then survive weeks of scrutiny before it can withdraw anything, while a lone honest agent waits and collects in full. A contested payout freezes the escrow of the whole cluster, so a thousand mouths become a cash flow problem rather than a cleverness problem. On the dune of the ledger each reward waits like a lotus that opens only when nobody objects, and the velvet layer of released payments marks the real contributor.
